tests.name: Neighbour order follows the edge list
5 000 vertices, 20 000 edges
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(1212)
n = 5000
edges = [random.sample(range(n), 2) for _ in range(20000)]
tests.expr: (sum(map(len, adj)), adj[0][:6], adj[1234][:6], max(degrees(n, edges)), sum(in_out_degrees(n, edges)[0][:100]))
tests.hint: Go through the edge list once. Scanning every edge for every vertex is O(V E).
